```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Proximal tube connected
    Given the proximal tube is connected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the controller reports the proximal tube is connected

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the GUI computes a "proximal tube disconnect" alarm
    And the alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: Obstruction detected
    Given the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the GUI activates an "obstruction" alarm
    And the alarm has high priority

  Scenario: Obstruction not detected
    Given the VTI is 100ml or more
    When the system is initialized
    Then the GUI does not activate an "obstruction" alarm

  Scenario: Leakage computation
    Given the sensor readings are valid
    When the system is initialized
    Then the GUI computes the amount of leakage (L/min) based on the sensor readings

  Scenario Outline: Proximal tube disconnect alarm priority
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the "proximal tube disconnect" alarm has medium priority
    Examples:
      | priority |
      | medium   |
      | high     |
      | low      |

  Scenario Outline: Obstruction alarm priority
    Given the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the "obstruction" alarm has high priority
    Examples:
      | priority |
      | high     |
      | medium   |
      | low      |

  Scenario Outline: Leakage computation with invalid sensor readings
    Given the sensor readings are invalid
    When the system is initialized
    Then the GUI does not compute the amount of leakage (L/min)
    Examples:
      | sensor_reading |
      | invalid        |
      | null           |
      | empty string   |
```
